name: Account order tracking
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Account order tracking.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Legacy customer-account theme surface. Shopify owns authentication, account data and native form processing; current customer accounts are managed outside the theme. Tracking links require merchant configuration or native fulfillment data.

settings.label: Tracking provider URL
settings.info: HTTPS URL or store-relative path. No credentials or placeholders in the host. Optional {order}, {email}, {tracking} placeholders are encoded. Otherwise values are sent as order, email and tracking query parameters. Configure only a provider that accepts this contract. Blank disables the form.
settings.how: Enter the tracking provider url. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Subheading
settings.default: Find available order and shipment information.
settings.how: Enter the subheading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show tracking number field
settings.how: Turn on “Show tracking number field” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show explanatory shipment stages
settings.info: Static guidance only; never live order status.
settings.how: Turn on “Show explanatory shipment stages” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show support button
settings.how: Turn on “Show support button” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Support heading

settings.label: Support text
settings.default: If your tracking information has not updated yet, contact support and our team can help review your order.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.
